fields.summary_ko.0: Following Anthropic (ANT) IPO, weakness in the AI sector persists with Nasdaq down approximately 18% year-to-date, Nvidia (NVDA) down 42% over four weeks, and Micron (MU) down 33% over one month.
fields.summary_ko.1: Raymond James' Matt Orton views current AI-related stocks as undergoing a 'clearance sale' and expects the market to stabilize, while Nomura's Charlie McElligott notes investors are selling stocks and moving to cash and U.S. Treasuries.
fields.summary_ko.2: UBS expects further S&P 500 gains while noting the risk-reward ratio is becoming more balanced, recommending reduced technology concentration and increased intermediate-term bonds.
